title: Mysterious Space
text: “Bird.”
“Yes, yes. Motoyasu-kun, Filo-chan. Come over here and grab hold of my tail feathers, would you?”
“Understood, I say.”
“Uu… got it.”
Filo-tan and I both grabbed hold of Hou-kun’s tail feathers together. Then Hou-kun touched Ark’s back.
“Motoyasu-kun, I can only offer some ordinary words, but do your best… I’m rooting for you, for the sake of the world that’s been erased.”
That… sounded very much like something Father, who had stayed behind in Melromarc to start the world over again, would say, and Ark held a finger to his lips as if to say it was a secret.

“When the loop happens, Motoyasu-kun, you’ll surely forget all about tonight. That’s a result of the very nature you were born with. But someday, somewhere, I want you to remember. I hope your journey ahead is filled with much happiness…”
Shhff…! In an instant, the scenery changed completely. Was that a Portal Skill, I wonder?

Before I knew it, I found myself in a place that resembled a library stretching endlessly toward the horizon. Within that library-like place sat equipment resembling Doctor’s workshop. Looking around, there was no one but Hou-kun, and when I looked up, stars twinkled overhead. What a strange place, indeed. And yet, somehow, the atmosphere resembled the innermost depths of those ruins found within the sanctuary of Filolial-sama.
“Ark has vanished!?”
“Don’t worry about the cat.”
Hou-kun then held his wing out toward a bookshelf, and two books came flying in from seemingly out of nowhere.
“What, what’s this~? Books~?”
Filo-tan asked Hou-kun.
“Yeah. Just a little something.”

Hou-kun opened the book and swiftly began rewriting something. Yet the characters he wrote seemed to vanish and revert back to how they were before… it looked rather like invisible ink being revealed by heat. Whatever could he be doing, I wondered?
“Where is here~?”

“Ah, this place. It’s a sort of separate dimension. The flow of time has been stopped here… so no matter how long you spend here, you won’t age a single day. This time, I’m borrowing it precisely because it’s a place that can’t be detected.”
“Hmm~?”
“I don’t quite understand, Hou-kun. Is this something I’m meant to learn eventually?”

“Yeah. In the future I glimpsed, however vaguely, you were always destined to end up releasing the hamster wheel here. Though I never imagined you’d arrive here by way of the single least likely outcome.”
Was that connected to what was written in the prophecy, I wonder? Ark must have been trying, without fail, to do something about the misfortune waiting for me.

“To get in here on your own, it only opens up on the cat’s back, all by itself, on a night of a full or new moon when the cat happens to be spacing out. This time, I had the cat open it for me. He hardly ever does it, you know.”
So a distortion in space forms on Ark’s back, does it?
“Is that what they call a Dimension Shield?”

“Nope. That distorts space, but this place… it’s something else entirely, a place that corresponds to an inverted world. It’s a space of anti-existence, you see. Both pluses and minuses have to be dealt with for the sake of your fate. Balance in all things, after all.”
Right then, sparkling brightly… my spear began glowing and moving on its own.
“Heh heh… what a strange twist of fate. That one trained here long ago, you know.”
“Is that so?”
“Yeah. You two will be together for a long time from now on. I’m sure a time will come to talk more about it, so get along well.”

Get along well or not, it’s simply the spear I use all the time. When Hou-kun closed the book, a massive magic circle raced across the ground, encircling Filo-tan and me each in turn. Then light was drawn in, into my spear and into Filo-tan’s claws respectively, and through that connection, something passed through the both of us as well.

“Well now, the arrangements have gone splendidly. The two of you are now bound more deeply with your weapons. Filo-chan, go on living just as before, and Motoyasu-kun… you’ll eventually be heading back once more, to the world you escaped from.”
“Hmm~?”
“Well then… shall we head back? Grab hold of my tail feathers tight now.”
As told, we grabbed onto Hou-kun’s tail feathers. And before I knew it, we were back in our original spot. But for some reason, I felt sleepy.
“Welcome back.”
“Uu… Filo’s sleepy~.”
“I did quite a lot to the two of you, after all. Guess it put a bit of a strain on you.”
“Ngh… uuuuu.”
“I’ll make sure you both get home safe and sound, so don’t worry.”
“You’ll probably forget all about tonight, but well then— sweet dreams…”
And so, with Ark’s gentle smile and waving hand as the last thing I saw, my consciousness faded away, together with Filo-tan’s――.

The next day, come to think of it, whatever had been done to me the night before had left my memory of it completely wiped clean. Filo-tan, on the other hand, seemed to remember, and appeared to be quietly confirming things with Ark and Hou-kun in a hushed voice.
“Well then, I’ll come visit again if I happen to pass by nearby.”
When everyone gathered to see them off, Ark smiled and waved.
“It’s a blessing that this place was such a comfortable one for you, nano~.”
Rival, oddly formal, saluted as it saw Ark off. I was absentmindedly waving my hand and so didn’t get around to picking a fight with it.
“Yeah. I can understand why you’re so fond of him. Get along well with Motoyasu-kun.”
“W-why would Gaelion need to, nano!?”
“Aren’t you two the type to bicker like good friends? From what the bird told me, it seems you dwelled within the Sacred Weapon too, so have fun with it.”
“Gaelion will… do her best, nano? You mean play around with Spear Hero… nano?”
Rival tilted its head at Ark’s words.
“Well… I understand your feelings when it comes to your older sister— no, your father. I’ve had to look after an adopted child myself, after all.”
“Made me look after about three generations, didn’t it? The second generation was really something else~.”
“Ahaha… Wyndia-chan, you get along well too. Just try not to get too worked up over your father.”
“Huh?”
“Nano?”
So it seemed, as Assistant and Rival both tilted their heads, picturing their pitiful respective parents.
“As for me, I don’t know if I’ll be able to come by again, but it was quite fun.”
So Hou-kun didn’t know if he’d be able to return again. What a shame, indeed.
“Motoyasu-kun is giving me such a strange look… I suppose the goosebumps really are your doing.”
“You’re a bird, aren’t you.”
“Now there’s no one left besides Naofumi-chan who can drink with me. It really is lonely~.”
Older Sister waved, looking genuinely reluctant to part from the bottom of her heart. Panda frowned at Older Sister’s display.
“If you want a drinking buddy that badly, why not call your little sister over~? You’ve got one, don’t you? Like the cat’s little brother, regardless of whether you two get along or not.”
The moment Hou-kun said that, Ark shot him a look that said “oh come on now.”
“Oh? Could you mean Raphtalia-chan~?”
“Whoops, well, going on talking forever doesn’t seem like a great idea, so I’ll be taking my leave now.”
“Yeah. See ya~.”

And so, when Ark traced a line across the sky with a finger, a hole opened up, and the two of them stepped in and vanished. What a peculiar way to depart, those two. Or so I thought to myself, at the time.
“Where is this…”

Before I knew it, I found myself in a strange space that should have been dark, yet somehow I alone could be seen clearly. Whatever was going on, I wondered? Thinking back a bit… I could recall the peaceful days spent with Father and the others, Ren, and Itsuki, back when we’d headed toward Faubrey. And yet, it also felt as though quite a considerable amount of time had passed since then. Just then, out of the darkness, Rival came fluttering down.
“Hey there, Motoyasu Kitamura, nano~. How’s it going, nano?”
Hm? Rival calling me by my full name, just like that?
This feels a bit unsettling, but I look around the surroundings without worrying about it. However, I do not understand it very well.
“Just where on earth is this place?”
“Where do you think it is? Nano.”

What kind of rival is this? As always, they seem to be making a fool of me in some way, but their gaze is somehow unsettling. Since it would be foolish to deal with them, I ignore the rival and start walking. There should be an exit somewhere, after all.
“Yuki-chan! Kou, Kuu-chan, Marin-chan, Midori!”
I call out to the Filolials, but no reply can be heard.
“Filo-tan!”
And I call out Filo-tan’s name, but... there is no answer. Just where on earth is this place? Then, right as I tried to check if I could use a portal, I noticed that my spear was not at hand.
“I do not have my spear!”
I immediately glare at the rival.
“Where is my spear!”
“As always, you are energetic and full of drive... That is precisely why you are also amusing, though, nano.”

What is the meaning of that attitude! For a rival, their reaction seems rather dull. However, their gaze is somehow bothersome. For a rival, I feel as though they hold some degree of familiarity toward me.
“Perhaps because you finally remembered the night of that day, you seem to have made it this far, and while I think it would be good if we could expect some slight changes, how is it? Nano.”
Above all, I feel that their choice of words is strange. For a rival, that ending of “nano” feels tacked on.
